method: TRAIN-only population-standardized OLS with intercept, normal equations with partial pivot floor 1e-12; no regularization or selection
output_semantics: Axis-specific scalar synthetic response; paired delta is alternative minus baseline in the same axis units.

accepted_reference_scope.model_row_selection: Each pinned file retains all 15 diagnostic heads. Only the three predeclared task-aligned axis/family combinations above are accepted as response-recovery references; other rows remain controls, not selected replacements.

fit_and_selection_policy.preprocessing: Means and population standard deviations fitted on the identified TRAIN rows only; stored with coefficients, never refitted on development or assessment.
fit_and_selection_policy.readout: One fit per predeclared axis/family/seed using identical TRAIN labels and five parameters; no model/hyperparameter/seed selection.
fit_and_selection_policy.future_bindings: New population, representation, target, dimension, support or temporal horizon requires a new instance identity, own contract/RER, prospectively frozen TRAIN-only fitting and selection rules, and independent assessment. This reference is not a universal default.

old_binding.disposition: Preserved unchanged as historical synthetic evidence; no retirement or replacement of its fitted artifacts.

dependency_gate: Before any new profile or instance relies on either historical OLS or this reference, link this decision and its limits in that profile contract/RER and instance dependencies, and supply its own validated readout binding. No such dependency is admitted by this record alone.
limitations: Fixed synthetic features, not learned encoder evidence
Matched head parameter count does not match nonlinear function classes
Raw polynomial misses periodic/hinge targets; other families miss the polynomial target
Normal equations can fail on singular or ill-conditioned designs; no robustness guarantee beyond the tested scope
